Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer provided is "Abby McGrew." The Predicted Answer states that the Super Bowl MVP in the relevant year (2002) was Tom Brady and that his wife was Gisele Bündchen. However, Tom Brady was not married to Gisele Bündchen in 2002, and she was not his wife at that time (they married in 2009). In reality, the MVP of the Super Bowl that year (Super Bowl XXXVI) was Tom Brady, but at that time, he was not married. "Abby McGrew" is the wife of Eli Manning, who won Super Bowl MVP in later years (not 2002). Therefore, the Ground Truth Answer "Abby McGrew" is not present in the Predicted Answer in substance, and the Predicted Answer in itself is factually inaccurate regarding both the identity and the timing.

Decision: FALSE
